plugin_genshin_description: Drives your BetterGI: run a One Dragon, config group or plan in one click, and hear in chat when it is done
plugin_genshin_source_bettergi_desc: Starts BetterGI to run a One Dragon, config group or plan; reads its config, run history and log; receives its notifications
plugin_genshin_source_bettergi_risk: Driving BetterGI means a third-party tool presses keys and moves the mouse in Genshin Impact for you. miHoYo's terms of service forbid unauthorized third-party tools, and BetterGI's own FAQ says the terms name third-party software / simulated input as a reason for bans and detection is still possible. Whether and what to run is your call; Kotone only starts it and reads its records. It never reads game memory or changes game files. github.com/babalae/better-genshin-impact
plugin_genshin_push_runs_when: Kotone started a BetterGI task, or BetterGI reports a start, finish or error (One Dragon, config group, plan)
plugin_genshin_push_runs_what: A card in chat: what is running and how it is going; updated in place when it finishes or fails, with a short note for her
plugin_genshin_notice_bettergi_body: BetterGI is an open-source tool you installed yourself, released under GPL-3.0. Kotone does not ship it, change it or use its code: it only talks to it across processes — starting it with its command line, reading the files it writes and receiving its notification webhook. Its config and log are read only on your PC and never sent anywhere.
plugin_genshin_off_note: Once on, run a One Dragon, config group or plan in your BetterGI from here in one click and hear in chat when it is done; or just ask her to do your Genshin dailies. You need to install BetterGI yourself first.
plugin_genshin_not_found_note: Enter its folder (the one with BetterGI.exe) in settings, or install it in a common place (for example D:\BetterGI).
plugin_genshin_webhook_title: Tell me when it is done
plugin_genshin_webhook_ok: BetterGI's notification webhook points to Kotone: finishes and errors show up in chat.
plugin_genshin_webhook_off: BetterGI's notification webhook doesn't point to Kotone, so you won't hear when it finishes. Click Fill in for me, or turn on Webhook in BetterGI's notification settings and enter the address below.
plugin_genshin_webhook_busy_note: BetterGI's config can't be changed while it is open (it would write it back): close it first, or fill it in yourself in its notification settings.
plugin_genshin_webhook_filled: Done. The old config is backed up at {backup}
plugin_genshin_plans_unsupported: This BetterGI has no plans yet (they start with 0.67).
plugin_genshin_busy_note: BetterGI is already open: Kotone can only hand it plans. Start a One Dragon or config group in BetterGI, or close it first.
plugin_genshin_automation_off: Genshin Impact is set to no automation input: BetterGI presses keys and moves the mouse for you, so turn on Allow automation input in Game profiles first.
plugin_genshin_path_desc: BetterGI's folder (the one with BetterGI.exe). Leave empty to look in a BetterGI folder on each drive and in the Start menu.
